about: Golden set for location matching (docs/PLAN-airports.md, PR A). Each case lists the airports a traveller from there would realistically use. `expect: []` means it should not be placed; `mustFlag` means the input is ambiguous, so even a right answer must be marked for checking. Score it with `node tools/score-matching.mjs`.
